evidence_sentence: It purges the transmit and receive queues, resets various TCP parameters, and initializes the receive MSS to avoid division by zero issues.
rationale: The fixed implementation uniquely assigns icsk->icsk_ack.rcv_mss = TCP_MIN_MSS, explicitly to prevent a division-by-zero issue. The vulnerable implementation performs the other cleanup and parameter resets but lacks any receive-MSS initialization. This sentence therefore specifies the patch-only mitigation.
rewritten_docstring: The function first checks the current state of the socket and sets it to TCP_CLOSE if it is not already closed. It handles various states according to RFC793, including stopping listening if in TCP_LISTEN state, and sending a reset if necessary. It purges the transmit and receive queues, resets various TCP parameters, and cleans up any fastopen-related fields before reporting any errors and returning the error code.
